papers.title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
papers.translated_title: AnyCam：任何事物皆可表征视频生成中的相机
papers.author: Weijie Lyu
papers.summary: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
papers.translated_summary: 相机控制的视频生成沿目标相机轨迹重新渲染视频，然而围绕物体移动相机——这是改变以物体为中心场景视角的最自然方式——仍然困难。现有方法要么以相机参数为条件，而相机参数在单目视频中具有尺度歧义，要么以显式几何如变形点云或深度为条件，而后者在大视角变化下会失效。我们提出AnyCam，一种以场景中的锚定物体来表示相机的方法：我们在3D中重建该物体并沿目标轨迹渲染它，这是一种尺度感知、视角完整且易于相对于物体指定的相机信号。视频扩散模型将源视频的内容和动态迁移到新视角。其H-Concat布局在时间上对齐源帧和目标帧，因此该模型可以蒸馏为AnyCam-AR，一种用于即时相机控制的流式少步生成器。两个模型均在配对的视频上训练，这些视频带有来自多相机视频和静态场景采集的像素对齐锚定渲染。在不同数据集和轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam在相机控制和视觉质量方面优于相机控制的视频生成和3D重建方法。

papers.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.translated_title: 用智能体视觉推理跟踪任意点
papers.author: Xuweiyi Chen
papers.summary: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
papers.translated_summary: 通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在目标检测、视频识别等诸多领域已超越专家视觉模型。然而，点对应关系对VLM而言颇具挑战，因为它超越了目标级识别：它要求在观测之间对同一物理表面点进行像素级定位，即便外观发生变化或该点消失后又重新出现。本文提出AgenTAP，一个基于VLM的智能体，直接预测点坐标与可见性，并对视频进行主动推理。该智能体从自身估计出发，自主选择要检查的内容，并利用由此获得的证据验证点的身份并精化其预测。在GPT-6 Astra上，它在点定位与可见性预测两方面均超越专家视觉模型，且无需针对对应关系进行微调。我们进一步利用AgenTAP在点消失后重新识别物理点并重新连接碎片化轨迹，构建了EgoTAP-4D，一个长时真实世界第一人称视频中的3D点轨迹数据集。在采样的重新出现的点上，其预测接近人类一致性，且将EgoTAP-4D加入D4RT训练可提升平均3D跟踪性能。

papers.title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
papers.translated_title: AI原生自编码器通信的频谱自适应与迁移学习
papers.author: Yalin E. Sagduyu
papers.summary: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. We further formulate layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem that identifies the most informative parameters to update during adaptation. This preserves the learned signal geometry and the deep decision structure while adapting lightweight front ends to fading- and impairment-induced mixing. For AE communications, we show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach the BER of fully retrained models. We provide a layer-wise study and quantify resource-performance trade-offs, showing that modest adaptation substantially reduces BER while cutting training time, multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters for resource-efficient implementation.
papers.translated_summary: 端到端物理层学习用自编码器（AE）取代了独立的调制、编码和检测操作，该自编码器由发射机和接收机处联合训练的编码器-解码器对组成。本文研究了基于自编码器的AI原生通信，并量化了其对信道模型中训练-测试失配的敏感性。仅在AWGN信道上训练的模型在匹配条件下可实现低误码率（BER），但在存在实际前端损伤的瑞利衰落信道上性能严重退化。为减少适应新信道条件所需的时间和能量，我们提出一种低延迟迁移学习流程，该流程从AWGN预训练系统出发，仅微调发射机和接收机层的一小部分子集，同时冻结其余部分。我们进一步将层选择建模为预算约束优化问题，以识别适应过程中最具信息量的待更新参数。这在适应轻量前端以应对衰落和损伤引起的混合的同时，保持了已学习的信号几何结构和深层判决结构。对于自编码器通信，我们表明部分更新可消除失配引起的误码率底限，并接近完全重训练模型的BER。我们提供了逐层研究并量化了资源-性能权衡，表明适度的适应可大幅降低BER，同时减少训练时间、乘累加（MAC）操作、能耗以及更新参数的比例，从而实现资源高效的实现。

papers.title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
papers.translated_title: 在没有视频的情况下改进和扩展视频编辑能力
papers.author: Ji Xie
papers.summary: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.
papers.translated_summary: 图像编辑模型能够遵循广泛的指令，但视频编辑模型仍然落后，部分原因是难以收集成对的源视频和编辑后视频。是否有可能在没有新配对视频的情况下，将先进的图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑器？我们提出图像到视频迁移（I2VT），该方法利用图像编辑器改进预训练视频编辑器，并将其扩展到新的编辑任务。它能够实现高效的后训练，无需架构更改，也无需新视频，仅使用单张图像。我们的核心思想是让视频编辑器扮演图像编辑器的角色：它将图像作为单帧视频进行编辑，由图像编辑器在每个去噪步骤中引导视频编辑器的预测。尽管视频编辑器在训练期间只看到单张图像，但在测试时，它将改进和扩展的能力应用于整个视频片段，同时保持时间一致性。为推进视频编辑的边界，我们提出OpenVE++，这是OpenVE-Bench的扩展，增加了四个对视频制作有用的新编辑任务，包括动作变化、表情变化、身体运动和场景重光照。我们在三种不同视频编辑器上的实验表明，I2VT提升了现有编辑能力并将其扩展到新任务，我们的模型在OpenVE-Bench和OpenVE++上均达到了最先进（SOTA）性能。

papers.title: LuxAvatar: Real-Time Relightable Head Avatars via Causal Neural Shading of 3D Intrinsic Proxies
papers.translated_title: LuxAvatar：通过3D内在代理的因果神经着色实现实时可重光照头部虚拟形象
papers.author: Yipengjing Sun
papers.summary: We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait. To achieve both 3D controllability and complex facial light transport, we factorize avatar synthesis into an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy and a causal autoregressive neural shader. This proxy disentangles canonical geometry and reflectance attributes, rapidly rasterizing deformed Gaussians into view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers. Conditioned on these buffers, our neural shader formulates forward rendering as a conditional video diffusion process, bypassing explicit PBR computation to synthesize realistic shading effects under target illumination. We achieve real-time streaming through heterogeneous distillation from a pretrained multi-step bidirectional relighting teacher to a two-step causal autoregressive neural shader, inheriting broad synthetic lighting priors while minimizing conditioning and decoding latency. To further specialize these priors to human heads, we construct a hybrid relighting dataset for domain-specific fine-tuning, capturing authentic facial dynamics and physically grounded light transport. Extensive experiments show that our framework enables 3D-controllable, real-time portrait animation and relighting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity, motion control, and lighting accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出LuxAvatar，一种前馈框架，用于从单张肖像实现实时头部化身动画与重光照。为实现3D可控性与复杂面部光传输，我们将化身合成分解为可动画的3D本征高斯代理与因果自回归神经着色器。该代理分离规范几何与反射率属性，将变形高斯快速光栅化为视角与运动一致的PBR缓冲区。以这些缓冲区为条件，我们的神经着色器将前向渲染表述为条件视频扩散过程，绕过显式PBR计算，在目标光照下合成逼真着色效果。我们通过异构蒸馏从预训练多步双向重光照教师模型到两步因果自回归神经着色器，实现实时流式传输，继承广泛的合成光照先验，同时最小化条件与解码延迟。为进一步将这些先验专门化到人头，我们构建混合重光照数据集用于领域特定微调，捕捉真实面部动态与物理基础的光传输。大量实验表明，我们的框架实现3D可控的实时肖像动画与重光照，在视觉保真度、运动控制与光照准确性上优于最先进方法。

papers.title: A Mesh for Every Moment
papers.translated_title: 每一刻的网格
papers.author: Roy Or-El
papers.summary: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame. Existing dynamic Gaussian splatting methods either model appearance alone or target isolated objects segmented by foreground masks, and all of them recover meshes by TSDF fusion or Poisson reconstruction, whose fixed grids limit the detail they can capture. At the core of MEMO is a per-Gaussian motion model inspired by Gaussian processes, which represents each Gaussian's position and rotation over time as a combination of temporal Gaussian kernels. The model keeps every Gaussian a valid surface element throughout the sequence and carries an implicit representation of the dynamic geometry, so a mesh can be derived at any time from a field defined by the Gaussians. Although common in real captures, large and fast motion poses a challenge that dynamic Gaussian splatting methods usually overlook. To account for it, we design a track-based initialization scheme that fits each Gaussian's initial trajectory to point tracks in closed form. We evaluate MEMO on Blender-Moments, a new benchmark of nine animated scenes with ground-truth meshes at every frame, and on two real-world datasets. MEMO reconstructs the most accurate geometry among state-of-the-art methods, and remains competitive in novel-view synthesis and training time. Project page: https://memo-4d.github.io
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出MEMO（a Mesh for Every MOment），一种重建完整动态场景几何的方法，该场景由多台同步相机捕获，并在每一帧提取网格。现有的动态高斯泼溅方法要么仅建模外观，要么针对由前景掩码分割出的孤立物体，并且它们都通过TSDF融合或泊松重建来恢复网格，其固定网格限制了所能捕获的细节。MEMO的核心是一种受高斯过程启发的逐高斯运动模型，它将每个高斯的位置和旋转随时间表示为时间高斯核的组合。该模型在整个序列中保持每个高斯为有效的表面元素，并携带动态几何的隐式表示，因此可以在任何时刻从高斯定义的场中导出网格。尽管在真实捕获中很常见，但大幅度快速运动构成了动态高斯泼溅方法通常忽视的挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们设计了一种基于轨迹的初始化方案，以闭式形式将每个高斯的初始轨迹拟合到点轨迹。我们在Blender-Moments（一个包含九个动画场景、每帧均有真值网格的新基准）和两个真实世界数据集上评估了MEMO。MEMO在最先进方法中重建出最准确的几何，并在新视角合成和训练时间方面保持竞争力。项目页面：https://memo-4d.github.io

papers.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
papers.translated_title: 代币化不在APX中
papers.author: Violeta Kastreva
papers.summary: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
papers.translated_summary: 在本文中，我们证明除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能够找到一个其目标值在最优值任意常数倍范围内的分词器，这意味着分词不属于APX复杂性类。我们针对直接分词和自底向上分词，在压缩目标或一元对数似然目标下，以及对于二进制或更大字母表，证明了这一点。我们进一步表明，即使在单字母表上，直接分词也是APX困难的，因此不存在多项式时间近似方案。

papers.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
papers.translated_title: 图像生成能帮助视觉推理吗？一项实证研究
papers.author: Xueyang Yu
papers.summary: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
papers.translated_summary: 语言模型用词语思考，那么多模态模型可能用图像思考。我们测试生成的辅助图像是否能改善视觉问题的答案。模型描述它需要的辅助图像，然后结合原始图像和生成的图像一起作答。在13组视觉语言模型与生成器配对中，生成使平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，在十个任务中有九个出现下降。两个统一模型BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B各自在八个任务上损失准确率。在VSTAR上，向相同的规划提示添加生成图像使准确率下降10.47个百分点。重复的图像编辑在不同任务上产生不同结果。ChartQAPro和MathVista始终低于其无生成基线，而ERQA在十次编辑后提升了三个百分点。

papers.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
papers.translated_title: 攻击策略选择可能误导监控评估者
papers.author: Charlie Griffin
papers.summary: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.
papers.translated_summary: AI监控器——即标记AI智能体危险行为的分类器——通常使用由攻击策略生成的对话记录进行评估，这些攻击策略充当部署中危险行为的代理。我们以一个已投产的OpenAI监控器作为案例研究进行评估，发现测得的假阴性率对生成攻击策略的方法以及该方法内部所施加的优化程度都高度敏感。在单一方法（强化学习）的不同优化水平下，该比率从0.5%到20.8%不等；在各方法最佳观测优化水平下（优化提示词 vs. 对话记录编辑），该比率从6.4%到23.0%不等。每个攻击策略都仅针对代理监控器开发：所有报告的结果均显示攻击能够迁移到留出的GPT-5.4目标监控器上。我们的结果表明，监控器规避评估很容易产生误导：仅使用基本攻击方法的评估可能会让人错误地确信监控器足够强大。对攻击策略选择的敏感性带来了一个问题：要将任何特定结果解释为关于部署性能的证据，需要提供正当性论证。攻击策略生成的对话记录是监控器在部署中必须标记的危险行为的代理。这些代理可能引入可见的人为痕迹，例如对监控器所见的指令中并不存在的“侧任务”进行推理，从而影响监控器的判断。鉴于上述敏感性，代理的选择可能改变评估的结论。因此，要将这些结果解读为关于部署的证据，需要单独提供合法性论证，说明这些代理为何具有信息量，包括对保守性的任何正当性说明。给出令人信服的论证仍是一个未解决的问题。

papers.title: DynMF2: Rigid Motion Factorization by Expectation-Maximization for Monocular 4D Reconstruction and Motion Segmentation
papers.translated_title: DynMF2：基于期望最大化的刚体运动分解用于单目4D重建与运动分割
papers.author: Agelos Kratimenos
papers.summary: A single casual video leaves a moving scene under-determined: a point seen once from each place can slide toward or away from the camera and still match every frame. We constrain the reconstruction with the structure of the motion itself. Building on DynMF, we model a scene's motion as a handful of SE(3) trajectories, each rigid, and let every point follow one of them alone, never a blend. DynMF2 computes this factorization directly from 3D point trajectories, with no rendering, by Expectation-Maximization (EM). Its M-step fits, in closed form, every rigid motion to the points assigned to it, and its E-step reassigns every point to the motion that explains it with the least error. The background is simply one more motion, the camera's, so no masks are needed. Three tools then revise the factorization: requery adds trajectories where the rendering shows parts the tracker missed, merge joins motions that move together, and split separates those that do not. Thus the number of motions follows the scene. Without masks, DynMF2 clearly outperforms the mask-based baselines in view synthesis on iPhone and NVIDIA and in 3D tracking on iPhone. It recovers what masks leave out, from thin parts and details to small movers far in the background. Its motions segment the moving parts of MOVi-F and iTACO scenes competitively, although DynMF2 is never trained to segment. What moves in a scene is not decided in advance: it emerges from the rigid motions themselves.
papers.translated_summary: 单段随意拍摄的视频会使动态场景欠定：从每个位置仅观测一次的点可以沿朝向或远离相机的方向滑动，却仍与每一帧匹配。我们利用运动本身的结构来约束重建。基于 DynMF，我们将场景运动建模为少量 SE(3) 轨迹，每条轨迹均为刚性，并让每个点仅跟随其中一条轨迹，绝不混合。DynMF2 通过期望最大化（EM）直接从 3D 点轨迹计算这一分解，无需渲染。其 M 步以闭式解将每条刚性运动拟合到分配给它的点，其 E 步将每个点重新分配给解释误差最小的运动。背景只是又一条运动——相机的运动，因此无需掩码。随后三种工具修正该分解：requery 在渲染显示跟踪器遗漏部分的位置添加轨迹，merge 合并一起运动的运动，split 分离不一起运动的运动。因此运动数量随场景而定。无需掩码，DynMF2 在 iPhone 和 NVIDIA 上的视图合成以及 iPhone 上的 3D 跟踪中明显优于基于掩码的基线。它恢复了掩码遗漏的内容，从细小部件和细节到背景深处的小型运动物体。其运动对 MOVi-F 和 iTACO 场景中运动部分的分割具有竞争力，尽管 DynMF2 从未被训练用于分割。场景中什么在运动并非预先决定：它从刚性运动本身中涌现。

papers.title: Direction of ESCRT-III-dependent membrane bending emerges from bilayer asymmetry
papers.translated_title: ESCRT-III依赖的膜弯曲方向源于双分子层不对称性
papers.author: Tran, J.
papers.summary: ESCRT-III is the cell's principal machinery for reverse-topology membrane scission, cutting necks from within. Yet purified ESCRT-III predominantly assembles on the outside of membranes and bends them the opposite way. How one polymer chooses its direction is a long-standing paradox. Here, we show that ESCRT-III supplies the force, but bilayer asymmetry sets the direction. In budding yeast, sphingolipid asymmetry is required for efficient intraluminal vesicle formation: without it, cargo sorting is impaired and endosomal intermediates accumulate. In reconstituted membranes, imposing either lipid or protein asymmetry across the bilayer is sufficient to orient ESCRT-III-driven deformation. Leaflet-resolved fluorescence-lifetime imaging reveals that both act through a single mechanism: unequal lipid packing between leaflets generates differential tensile stress that dictates which way the membrane bends. Reconstituted membranes are typically symmetric; cellular membranes are not. This resolves the reverse-topology paradox and identifies bilayer asymmetry as a directional cue available to any membrane-remodeling machine.
papers.translated_summary: ESCRT-III是细胞执行反向拓扑膜剪切、从内部切割膜颈的主要机器。然而，纯化的ESCRT-III主要组装在膜的外侧，并向相反方向弯曲膜。一种聚合物如何选择其方向，是一个长期存在的悖论。在此，我们表明ESCRT-III提供力，但双分子层不对称决定方向。在芽殖酵母中，鞘脂不对称是高效腔内囊泡形成所必需的：缺乏它时，货物分选受损，内体中间体积累。在重构膜中，施加脂质或蛋白质跨双分子层的不对称足以定向ESCRT-III驱动的形变。小叶分辨的荧光寿命成像揭示，两者通过单一机制起作用：小叶之间不等的脂质堆积产生差异拉伸应力，从而决定膜向哪个方向弯曲。重构膜通常是 symmetric 的；细胞膜则不是。这解决了反向拓扑悖论，并将双分子层不对称识别为任何膜重塑机器都可利用的方向线索。

papers.title: Dynamic gene-body chromatin accessibility is associated with a stage-dependent transcriptional upregulation during germination of fission yeast spores
papers.translated_title: 动态基因体染色质可及性与裂殖酵母孢子萌发过程中阶段依赖性转录上调相关
papers.author: Shogaki, Y.
papers.summary: Variations in the expression of histone genes influence the process of breaking dormancy in fission yeast spore cells. Since histones play a crucial role in chromatin organization, alterations in their expression impact chromatin states during spore germination, where such changes are vital. Although chromatin accessibility state has been studied in proliferating cells, there has been no specific research on spores. In this study, using ATAC-seq to examine chromatin accessibility in fission yeast spores, we found that ATAC-seq peaks frequently appeared as broad regions in gene-body in addition to promoter-linked narrow regions. Narrow peaks representing high chromatin accessibility at transcription start sites (TSSs) observed in proliferating cells were maintained in dormant spores as well as germinating spores, whereas broad peaks that cover gene-body were redistributed among different genes as germination progressed. The transition of broad open chromatin on gene-body was often linked with a stage-dependent transcriptional upregulation determined by scRNA-seq throughout dormancy breaking. Thus, the spore-specific chromatin alterations contribute to transcriptional changes observed during germination.
papers.translated_summary: 组蛋白基因表达的变化影响裂殖酵母孢子细胞休眠打破的过程。由于组蛋白在染色质组织中发挥关键作用，其表达的改变会影响孢子萌发过程中的染色质状态，而这些变化至关重要。尽管染色质可及性状态已在增殖细胞中得到研究，但尚无针对孢子的专门研究。在本研究中，利用ATAC-seq检测裂殖酵母孢子中的染色质可及性，我们发现ATAC-seq峰除了出现在启动子相关的窄区域外，还频繁出现在基因体中的宽区域。在增殖细胞中观察到的代表转录起始位点（TSSs）高染色质可及性的窄峰在休眠孢子和萌发孢子中均得以维持，而覆盖基因体的宽峰则随着萌发进展在不同基因之间重新分布。基因体上宽开放染色质的转变通常与由scRNA-seq确定的整个休眠打破过程中阶段依赖性的转录上调相关联。因此，孢子特异性的染色质改变促成了萌发过程中观察到的转录变化。

papers.title: Do single-cell foundation models need 512 dimensions for one number?
papers.translated_title: 单细胞基础模型真的需要一个数字就用512维来表示吗？
papers.author: Zhang, L.
papers.summary: Single-cell foundation models represent counts through high-dimensional value embeddings or ranked feature tokens. We asked how many dimensions counts need and what network computes. In a controlled Transformer, a four-dimensional value track separated from a wide gene-identity backbone retains nearly all masked-prediction net gain; a straight line replaces pretrained value curves with little transfer loss. Across evaluated cohorts, clamping detected-gene values retains most gain in annotation, surface-protein prediction and perturbation-shift consistency, consistent with the prevalence of single-molecule counts. A two-feature encoder combining tie-free rank and within-cell standardized magnitude improves controlled retraining and preserves annotation when grafted onto pretrained scGPT. Gene offsets and three linear cell-level scalars approximate masked prediction and predict responses to count thinning; depth leads in the controlled model, while cell type leads in scGPT. Matched controls show that attribution, attention, dictionary and probe readouts can reflect depth, gene frequency, hub degree or directions that transfer little output.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞基础模型通过高维值嵌入或排序特征标记来表示计数。我们探究了计数需要多少维度以及网络计算了什么。在一个受控Transformer中，与宽基因身份主干分离的四维值轨道保留了几乎全部掩码预测净增益；一条直线替代预训练值曲线，迁移损失很小。在所评估的队列中，钳制检测到的基因值在注释、表面蛋白预测和扰动偏移一致性中保留了大部分增益，这与单分子计数的普遍性一致。一个结合无并列排序和细胞内标准化幅度的双特征编码器改善了受控重训练，并在移植到预训练scGPT上时保留了注释性能。基因偏移和三个线性细胞级标量近似掩码预测，并预测对计数稀释的响应；在受控模型中深度领先，而在scGPT中细胞类型领先。匹配对照表明，归因、注意力、字典和探针读出可以反映深度、基因频率、枢纽度或迁移输出很少的方向。

papers.title: Phase-separated FRM proteins create signaling subdomains in inter-organelle junctions
papers.translated_title: 相分离的FRM蛋白在细胞器间连接处形成信号传导亚结构域
papers.author: Deng, H.
papers.summary: Endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane junctions (EPJs) house the calcium-signaling machinery that mediates calcium; release from the ER and its reentry into the ER. How these opposing functions are coordinated at EPJs is unknown. Here we show that neuronal EPJs are patch-like membrane contacts partitioned into discrete, adjacent subdomains containing the calcium-release and calcium-reentry machineries. Through a forward genetic screen, we identified the evolutionarily conserved FERM-family proteins FRM-4 and FRM-1 as central organizers of this architecture. FRM-4 and FRM-1 assemble EPJs by bridging the membranes, recruiting calcium-signaling components, and establishing the subdomains. Loss of FRM proteins disrupts both signaling domains and attenuates neuronal calcium responses and plasticity. FRM proteins and calcium-signaling molecules undergo phase separation at EPJs in vivo. Purified FRM proteins phase separate in vitro and suffice to partition calcium channels into their correct subdomains. Thus, phase separation creates molecular and functional subdomains at organelle junctions.
papers.translated_summary: 内质网-质膜连接（EPJs）容纳介导钙信号传导的钙信号机制，该机制调控钙从内质网释放及其再进入内质网。这些相反功能在EPJs处如何协调尚不清楚。本研究表明，神经元EPJs是斑块状膜接触，被分隔为离散的相邻亚结构域，分别包含钙释放和钙再进入机制。通过正向遗传筛选，我们鉴定出进化上保守的FERM家族蛋白FRM-4和FRM-1是该结构的中枢组织者。FRM-4和FRM-1通过桥接膜、招募钙信号组分并建立亚结构域来组装EPJs。FRM蛋白缺失会破坏两个信号结构域，并减弱神经元钙反应和可塑性。FRM蛋白与钙信号分子在体内EPJs处发生相分离。纯化的FRM蛋白在体外发生相分离，并足以将钙通道分配至正确的亚结构域。因此，相分离在细胞器连接处创建了分子和功能亚结构域。

papers.title: A dynamic proteomic HECT E3 ligase screen reveals substrate exclusivity and redundancies.
papers.translated_title: 动态蛋白质组学HECT E3连接酶筛选揭示底物排他性与冗余性。
papers.author: Parmar, B. S.
papers.summary: Cells maintain proteostasis through constant purge of proteins, complexes and large assemblies via the ubiquitin proteasome system (UPS). As a catalyst of ubiquitin transfer, E3 ligases determine the fate of their substrates, and to an extent, of the cell. Current approaches in identifying E3-substrate pairs largely overlook the dynamic nature of their interaction and the functional implications on cellular proteostasis. To address this, we incorporated a pSILAC-enabled dynamic proteomics into a knockdown (KD) screen for the HECT E3 ligase family. Our approach resolved the protein-level accumulation dynamics in response to HECT E3 KD and revealed extensive UPS-wide redundancy. Interestingly, our data also revealed compensation amongst E3s, as well as compensation of individual protein synthesis rate, in response to KD-induced accumulation. Statistical, machine learning and network analyses revealed unique functional niches and hierarchy of KD response for individual HECT E3s. As a mechanistic proof of principle, we show compensation along HUWE1, HECTD1 and TRIP12 axis with implications on MCL1 turnover and mitochondrial quality control. Overall, we here provide a high-confidence list of putative HECT E3 substrates and dependencies along with the interaction network that can be explored via an interactive tool. Our analysis framework is adaptable to larger protease screens and may positively inform the targeted protein degradation field towards precise therapeutic targets.
papers.translated_summary: 细胞通过泛素蛋白酶体系统（UPS）持续清除蛋白质、复合物和大分子组装体来维持蛋白质稳态。作为泛素转移的催化剂，E3连接酶决定其底物的命运，并在一定程度上决定细胞的命运。目前鉴定E3-底物配对的方法在很大程度上忽视了其相互作用的动态性质以及对细胞蛋白质稳态的功能影响。为解决这一问题，我们将基于pSILAC的动态蛋白质组学整合到HECT E3连接酶家族的敲低（KD）筛选中。我们的方法解析了响应HECT E3 KD的蛋白质水平积累动态，并揭示了广泛的UPS层面冗余性。有趣的是，我们的数据还揭示了E3之间的补偿，以及响应KD诱导的积累而发生的个体蛋白质合成速率的补偿。统计分析、机器学习和网络分析揭示了各个HECT E3独特的功能生态位和KD响应的层级关系。作为机制性原理验证，我们展示了沿HUWE1、HECTD1和TRIP12轴的补偿及其对MCL1周转和线粒体质量控制的影响。总体而言，我们在此提供了一份高置信度的推定HECT E3底物及其依赖性列表，以及可通过交互式工具探索的相互作用网络。我们的分析框架可适用于更大规模的蛋白酶筛选，并可能为靶向蛋白质降解领域提供积极信息，助力精准治疗靶点的发现。

papers.title: Evaluation of the Biological Effects and Specificity of the Novel Dihydroceramide Desaturase 1 inhibitor PR280 and its analogues
papers.translated_title: 新型二氢神经酰胺去饱和酶1抑制剂PR280及其类似物的生物学效应与特异性评价
papers.author: Peperno, D. M.
papers.summary: Emerging evidence suggests that dihydroceramide desaturase (DES1) plays key roles in many cellular biologies and pathologies, underscoring a need for DES1 inhibitors, both as research tools and potential therapeutic agents. In this study, we have evaluated the recently reported novel DES1 inhibitor PR280 and its newly synthesized analog PR280b. We find that while both compounds are potent in vitro and in situ DES1 inhibitors, they induced broader changes in cellular sphingolipids, most notably increased ceramide levels, that go beyond DES1 inhibition and had modest effects on DES1-driven biologies including anchorage-independent survival, apoptosis, and autophagy. Overall, although this limits the direct utility of PR280 as a specific DES1 inhibitor, this highlights the potential of this scaffold for further inhibitor development aimed at maintaining the DES1 inhibitory activity while reducing off-target effects.
papers.translated_summary: 新出现的证据表明，二氢神经酰胺去饱和酶（DES1）在多种细胞生物学和病理学过程中发挥关键作用，这凸显了开发DES1抑制剂的必要性，既可作为研究工具，也可作为潜在的治疗药物。在本研究中，我们评估了近期报道的新型DES1抑制剂PR280及其新合成的类似物PR280b。我们发现，虽然这两种化合物在体外和原位均是强效的DES1抑制剂，但它们引起了细胞鞘脂类的广泛变化，最显著的是神经酰胺水平升高，这些变化超出了DES1抑制的范围，并对DES1驱动的生物学过程（包括锚定非依赖性存活、凋亡和自噬）产生了适度的影响。总体而言，尽管这限制了PR280作为特异性DES1抑制剂的直接应用价值，但这也凸显了该骨架在进一步抑制剂开发中的潜力，目标是在保持DES1抑制活性的同时减少脱靶效应。

papers.title: Nanoscale architecture of malaria sporozoite formation
papers.translated_title: 疟原虫孢子子形成的纳米级结构
papers.author: Du, E. W.
papers.summary: Plasmodium falciparum parasites rapidly form thousands of infectious daughter cells, called sporozoites, within single oocysts during their development in the mosquito midgut. How parasites accurately compartmentalize these daughter cells remains poorly understood, mostly due to the exceedingly large oocyst volume (circa 113,000 m3 at the peak of sporozoite segmentation) and the substantial number of cells (5,000-10,000 sporozoites) hampering detailed ultrastructural studies. Here, we use a pre-commercial focused ion beam-scanning electron microscopy platform and custom-trained deep learning models to reconstruct at nanometer resolution the overarching cellular ultrastructure of two oocysts during mid- and late sporozoite formation. We unveil a highly synchronous segmentation process occurring with a striking degree of accuracy and reconstruct faithful stepwise interactions between key organelles in the different growth phases that likely ensure the fidelity of organellar segregation. We discover that sporozoites release membrane-bound cytoplasmic droplets, possibly to refine cell shape in preparation for their motility that drives transmission to humans. Contrary to previous assumptions, in both stages we conclusively visualize a single, interconnected sporoblast which we reason may help precisely coordinate signaling events that drive daughter cell formation. Our study provides foundational insight at unprecedented resolution into the ultrastructural features and changes characterizing the segmentation of P. falciparum sporozoites, conceivably the deadliest unicellular organisms in human history.
papers.translated_summary: 恶性疟原虫寄生虫在蚊中肠发育过程中，于单个卵囊内迅速形成数千个具有感染性的子细胞，称为子孢子。寄生虫如何精确地将这些子细胞区室化，目前仍知之甚少，主要原因是卵囊体积极其巨大（在子孢子分节高峰期约为113,000 m3），且细胞数量众多（5,000-10,000个子孢子），阻碍了详细的超微结构研究。在此，我们使用一个商业化前的聚焦离子束-扫描电子显微镜平台和自定义训练的深度学习模型，以纳米分辨率重建了子孢子形成中期和晚期两个卵囊的整体细胞超微结构。我们揭示了一个高度同步的分节过程，其准确性令人瞩目，并重建了不同生长阶段关键细胞器之间忠实的逐步相互作用，这些相互作用很可能确保了细胞器分离的保真度。我们发现子孢子释放膜结合的细胞质液滴，可能是为了精修细胞形状，为其驱动向人类传播的运动性做准备。与先前的假设相反，在两个阶段中我们都确凿地可视化了一个单一的、相互连接的孢子母细胞，我们认为这可能有助于精确协调驱动子细胞形成的信号事件。我们的研究以空前的分辨率提供了关于恶性疟原虫子孢子分节所特有的超微结构特征和变化的基础性认识，恶性疟原虫可以说是人类历史上最致命的单细胞生物。

papers.title: Synaptojanin 2 is required for neuronal mRNA localization, mitochondrial structure and function, and synaptic metabolism
papers.translated_title: Synaptojanin 2 是神经元 mRNA 定位、线粒体结构与功能以及突触代谢所必需的
papers.author: Gibbs, W.
papers.summary: Neurons rely on local mRNA transport to support the metabolic and structural demands of their distal compartments. Synaptojanin 2a (Synj2a), a mitochondria-associated phosphoinositide phosphatase, binds numerous mitochondrial mRNAs via an RNA recognition motif (RRM) and delivers them to axons and dendrites. Among these, PINK1 mRNA transport is particularly critical for mitochondrial quality control. Here we show that this RNA transport function, independent of Synj2s catalytic activity, is required for PINK1-dependent mitochondrial quality control, synaptic bioenergetics, and neuronal resilience. We made mice and human iPSC-derived neurons carrying RRM point mutations that disrupt RNA binding while preserving both phosphatase domains. The mutations also reduced endogenous Synj2 protein levels, indicating that RNA binding contributes to Synj2 stability. Rescue experiments with the RRM targeted to the outer mitochondrial membrane were therefore necessary to isolate which effects are due to RNA-binding. Neurons with the mutated RRM failed to localize PINK1 mRNA to neurites. Consequently, depolarizing mitochondria in these neurites failed to stabilize PINK1 protein or cause phosphoubiquitin to accumulate on mitochondria. Re-expressing the RRM rescued these defects, confirming that RNA-binding rather than phosphatase activity drives the phenotype. Mutant mice showed abnormal mitochondrial cristae ultrastructure and reduced respiratory capacity in synaptosomes. Metabolic profiling revealed extensive reprogramming, most notably increased glycolytic flux, elevated branched-chain amino acids and reduced cholesterol. Despite compensatory reprogramming, mutant neurons showed heightened vulnerability to mitochondrial and excitotoxic stress. This vulnerability was partially rescued by the mitochondrially-targeted RRM. These findings establish Synj2-mediated mRNA transport as a significant mechanism that supports mitochondrial homeostasis.
papers.translated_summary: 神经元依赖局部mRNA运输来满足其远端区室的代谢和结构需求。突触短杆蛋白2a（Synj2a）是一种与线粒体相关的磷酸肌醇磷酸酶，通过RNA识别基序（RRM）结合多种线粒体mRNA，并将它们运送至轴突和树突。其中，PINK1 mRNA的运输对线粒体质量控制尤为关键。本研究表明，这种不依赖Synj2s催化活性的RNA运输功能，是PINK1依赖性线粒体质量控制、突触生物能量学和神经元韧性所必需的。我们构建了携带RRM点突变的小鼠和人类iPSC来源神经元，这些突变破坏了RNA结合，同时保留了两个磷酸酶结构域。这些突变还降低了内源性Synj2蛋白水平，表明RNA结合有助于Synj2的稳定性。因此，必须进行将RRM靶向至线粒体外膜的拯救实验，以分离出哪些效应是由RNA结合引起的。携带突变RRM的神经元未能将PINK1 mRNA定位至神经突。因此，在这些神经突中去极化线粒体未能稳定PINK1蛋白或导致磷酸泛素在线粒体上积累。重新表达RRM可挽救这些缺陷，证实是RNA结合而非磷酸酶活性驱动了该表型。突变小鼠表现出异常的线粒体嵴超微结构和突触体中降低的呼吸能力。代谢谱分析揭示了广泛的重编程，最显著的是糖酵解通量增加、支链氨基酸升高和胆固醇降低。尽管存在代偿性重编程，突变神经元对线粒体和兴奋性毒性应激表现出更高的脆弱性。这种脆弱性被靶向线粒体的RRM部分挽救。这些发现确立了Synj2介导的mRNA运输作为支持线粒体稳态的重要机制。

papers.title: Protocol for generating 3D mesenchymal stromal cell spheroids using serum-free medium and differentiating them into endothelial-like Cells
papers.translated_title: 使用无血清培养基生成3D间充质基质细胞球体并将其分化为内皮样细胞的方案
papers.author: Li, S.
papers.summary: Three-dimensional (3D) cultures of mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) replicate in vivo conditions more accurately than two-dimensional (2D) cultures. This protocol outlines a simple and cost-efficient approach for generating mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) spheroids, which typically form within 1-3 days and are suitable for endothelial differentiation. Accutase can be applied to dissociate the spheroids into single cells for downstream analysis. A combination of growth factors is used to induce the differentiation of MSC spheroids into endothelial-like structures, which express key endothelial markers such as von Willebrand factor (vWF) and CD31, as confirmed by immunofluorescence.

papers.title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa lectins LecA and LecB differentially engage and activate the EphA2 receptor

papers.author: Senin, C.
papers.summary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a critical nosocomial pathogen responsible for severe and often difficult-to-treat infections in humans. Despite their central role in early host-pathogen interactions, the carbohydrate-binding lectins LecA and LecB remain largely underexplored compared to other P. aeruginosa virulence factors. Here, we show that LecA and LecB activate the human receptor tyrosine kinase EphA2 in a time- and carbohydrate-dependent manner in lung epithelial cells. Whereas LecB directly engages EphA2 primarily through protein-glycan binding, LecA activates EphA2 indirectly via interactions with the glycosphingolipid Gb3. Both lectins strongly colocalize with EphA2 at the host plasma membrane and trigger downstream CrkII phosphorylation via canonical EphA2 signaling. Owing to their tetravalent nature, LecA and LecB can cross-link membrane receptors, driving lateral membrane reorganization that initiates downstream signaling. Moreover, simultaneous engagement of both lectins at the plasma membrane further potentiates EphA2 activation. Finally, we demonstrate that live P. aeruginosa preferentially adheres to membrane domains where EphA2 concomitantly accumulates, inducing receptor activation in host cells. Collectively, these findings identify EphA2 as a pivotal host receptor mediating LecA- and LecB-driven signal transduction and provide new mechanistic insights into how P. aeruginosa exploits human lung epithelial cells during infection.

papers.title: Circulating protein profiling identifies prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral Sclerosis

Blood-based biomarkers offer a scalable approach to stratify patients and support therapeutic development. We identified serum proteins associated with survival in both cohorts. GSN, IGFBP2 and MEGF10 added prognostic information beyond clinical variables and neurofilament light chain (NfL). These circulating proteins are therefore candidate biomarkers for improved prognostic assessment that may lead to improved precision-medicine approa

papers.title: Insights from a Decade of Hereditary Cancer Genetic Testing from India: A Retrospective Study
papers.translated_title: 印度遗传性癌症基因检测十年洞察：一项回顾性研究
papers.author: Menon, R.
papers.summary: Background Hereditary cancers account for approximately 5% to 10% of malignancies, with inherited susceptibility more frequently identified in individuals with early-onset disease or a significant family history. However, large-scale study of germline cancer susceptibility across multiple tumor types remains limited from India and the broader South Asian population. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 24,320 individuals who underwent germline hereditary cancer testing at MedGenome Labs Ltd., Bangalore, India, between 2016 and 2025. Testing was performed primarily using clinically validated multi-gene targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) panels (N = 22,773), and for a subset of these cases were analyzed using multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification (MLPA) (N = 4,524). Additionally, MLPA confirmatory test alone was done for 1,547 samples. The major cancer subgroups analyzed were breast (N = 10,292), ovarian (N = 3,935), colorectal (N = 1,267), prostate (N = 762), and endometrial (N = 539) cancers, with 2,764 asymptomatic individuals with a positive family history. Results The overall diagnostic yield was 23.9%, highest in colorectal (42.1%) followed by ovarian (31.6%), endometrial (22.3%), breast (20.3%), and prostate (8.7%) cancers. Family history of the corresponding cancer was associated with higher diagnostic yield across most major cancer types, whereas prostate cancer showed a higher yield among individuals reporting a family history of other cancers. Diagnostic yield generally decreased with increasing age in breast, colorectal, ovarian, and endometrial cancers, but increased with age in prostate cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 predominated in breast and ovarian cancers, mismatch repair genes in colorectal and endometrial cancers, and BRCA2 in prostate cancer. The recurrent BRCA1 c.68_69delAG (p.Glu23ValfsTer17) variant was identified in 351 individuals. The identified BRCA1 gene mutations correlated with functional consequence data from published mutagenesis study. Among breast cancer cases, the ER-/HER2- subtype showed the highest diagnostic yield (25.5%). Re-analysis of VUS using autoACMG classifier followed by manual review confirmed 277 of 443 samples (62.5%) as pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP). Of the remaining VUS, 3.2% were classified as VUS-High using VUS-Grader tool. Additionally, manual review of 74 CNV-positive samples classified as VUS resulted in the reclassification of 41 (55.4%) as likely pathogenic, increasing the diagnostic yield by 1.4 percentage points. Among 4,524 individuals who underwent combined NGS and MLPA testing, CNVs were identified in 251 (5.5%), including 59 cases detected by MLPA but not by NGS. Conclusions This retrospective study represents the largest characterization of hereditary cancer susceptibility across major cancer types in South Asia, encompassing 24,320 samples. The findings support comprehensive multi-gene testing and population-adapted testing strategies to improve hereditary cancer risk assessment and precision oncology.

papers.title: Contextual DNA methylation QTLs link adversity responsivity to immune changes and evolutionary trade-offs

papers.author: Czamara, D.
papers.summary: Childhood adversity (CA) is one of the strongest risk factors for psychiatric but also numerous medical disorders, yet only a subset of exposed individuals develops these outcomes. Gene-by-environment interactions have long been proposed to account for this variability, but identifying the specific variants involved has proven difficult in studies using clinical endpoints. We therefore mapped interaction effects between genetic variants and CA at the molecular level, testing for contextual methylation quantitative trait loci (contmeQTLs) in peripheral blood from 3,471 adolescents and adults across six cohorts. Meta-analysis identified 5,120 contmeQTLs, >99% acting in cis, of which 20% were already detectable in three independent childhood cohorts (N=780), indicating that these effects emerge in temporal proximity to exposure. ContmeQTLs were enriched for immune-related pathways, particularly the major histocompatibility (MHC)/human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-complex, were associated with altered expression of HLA and other immune regulators, and captured disease risk beyond that explained by baseline meQTLs. A polygenic interaction responsivity score, constructed from contmeQTL variants, predicted both a larger acute transcriptional response to infection and a greater shift towards a pro-inflammatory plasma profile in CA-exposed adults, including in UK Biobank. Using ancient DNA, we found that these responsive alleles have been under positive selection, identifying molecular responsivity to adversity as an evolutionarily shaped trait whose benefit under acute challenge is accompanied by liability to immune-mediated and psychiatric disease.

papers.title: Community pharmacy responses to online reviews: a national cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 社区药房对在线评论的回应：一项全国性横断面研究
papers.author: Sambore, D.
papers.summary: Objectives: Online reviews constitute a source of information on the experience of users in community pharmacies. The way in which pharmacists engage with them remains poorly documented. The objective was to describe the frequency, determinants, and content of the responses provided by French pharmacy teams to reviews published on Google Maps. Methods: Cross-sectional observational study. Public reviews from nearly all French community pharmacies (approximately 20 000) were collected automatically between September and October 2026. For each review, the rating, the text of the review, the time since its publication, and the text of the response, if it existed, were collected. Factors associated with the response were studied using logistic regression. Sentiment of the reviews and the tone of the responses were automatically coded according to a predefined grid. The presence of reviews generated by artificial intelligence, as well as potential interventions on the ratings, were explored.\newline Results: In total, 1 008 024 extractions (729 521 reviews and 278 504 responses) concerning 19 985 pharmacies were analysed. A response was present for 38% of reviews and 67.5% of pharmacies had responded at least once. The response rate was higher for negative reviews (one or two stars) than for positive reviews (five stars) (adjusted OR 1.35; 95% CI [1.33--1.38]; adjusted risk difference +3.6 percentage points; 95% CI [3.3--3.8]), and these responses were approximately twice as long (adjusted geometric mean ratio 3.03; 95% CI [3.01--3.06]). The tone of the responses was very widely judged to be appropriate. Comments generated by artificial intelligence seem to be appearing progressively and represent approximately 3-4% in 2026. The removal of poor ratings appears to be marginal. Conclusions: Community pharmacists regularly and appropriately respond to online reviews, including, and in particular, less positive ones. These results could serve in the development of specific professional recommendations aimed at securing this practice.

papers.title: Plausibly Causal Plasma Proteins in Psychiatric Disorders: A Proteogenomic Appraisal
papers.translated_title: 精神病学障碍中可能具有因果关系的血浆蛋白：一项蛋白质基因组学评估
papers.author: Margelyte, R.
papers.summary: Importance: Large-scale plasma proteomic studies have linked hundreds of proteins to psychiatric disorders, but it is unclear which reflect causal biology rather than confounding or consequences of illness. Objective: To determine which plasma proteins associated with depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and psychotic disorders have genetic evidence of a causal role. Design, Setting, and Participants: This proteogenomic study combined genetic analyses with cross-sectional and longitudinal analyses in the UK Biobank (UKB) cohort (N=52,615). Associations of 2,923 plasma proteins were tested using two-sample Mendelian randomisation (MR) and genetic colocalisation with common-variant protein quantitative trait loci (pQTLs) from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (N=34,557). Findings were appraised via a rule-based framework combining instrument validity with genetic analyses using blood and brain expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) and rare-variant MR. Exposures: Measured and genetically proxied plasma protein levels. Main Outcomes and Measures: Prevalent and incident diagnoses of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and psychotic disorders; summary statistics from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) for depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia. Results: A total of 1,685 proteins were involved in protein-disorder associations in UKB after multiple testing correction, of which 26 proteins (32 protein-disorder pairs) met both MR and colocalisation (MR false discovery rate <0.05 and posterior probability of colocalisation [≥]0.8). After independent genetic validation, 9 disorder-protein pairs involving 7 proteins (CD40, ADAM22, CDHR1, PDIA3, SEMA3F, DSG3, and DDR1) met criteria for credible causal evidence, led by CD40, an immune signalling receptor, for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. Specifically, higher genetically predicted CD40 levels were associated with lower risk of schizophrenia (odds ratio [OR] 0.90; 95%CI 0.85-0.95) and bipolar disorder (OR 0.89; 95%CI 0.84-0.95), supported by directionally concordant colocalised brain eQTL and rare-variant MR evidence. Conclusions and Relevance: Few plasma protein associations with major psychiatric disorders had credible genetic support for causality, demonstrating that multi-layer appraisal across molecular layers, tissues, and genetic variant classes is required before nominating proteomic targets. CD40, an immune receptor targeted by drugs in clinical development, showed robust protective genetic support across schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, warranting focused mechanistic and therapeutic investigation.

papers.title: DNA capture and amplicon enrichment approaches for next-generation sequencing of Mycoplasma genitalium directly from clinical samples
papers.translated_title: 直接从临床样本中进行生殖支原体下一代测序的DNA捕获与扩增子富集方法
papers.author: Guiraud, J.
papers.summary: Direct genome sequencing of Mycoplasma genitalium from clinical specimens is challenging due to the organism's low bacterial load. We developed and compared two DNA enrichment strategies - amplicon-based and hybridisation capture-based - coupled with next-generation sequencing, and assessed the suitability of DNA capture for whole-genome sequencing and high-resolution molecular typing. The enrichment approaches, RNA bait hybridisation and targeted sequence amplification, were combined with paired-end sequencing on the Illumina iSeq 100. Method performance was evaluated in 89 M. genitalium-positive specimens across five genomic loci: 23S and 16S rRNA, and parC and gyrA for macrolide, tetracycline, and fluoroquinolone resistance, respectively, and mgpB for phylogenetic analysis. Regarding antimicrobial resistance (AMR) determinants, the multiplex amplicon sequencing method demonstrated the highest sensitivity, at 93.3-98.9%. Although < 50% of samples were characterised using DNA capture, concordance between the two methods was excellent. Using DNA capture, 24.7% of specimens achieved a minimum coverage of 95% at 1x depth. Sequencing success was inversely correlated with human DNA contamination and the presence of low-quality reads. Whole-genome single-nucleotide polymorphism analysis provided higher discriminatory power than multi-locus sequence typing schemes and confirmed the clonality of multidrug-resistant M. genitalium strains belonging to the mgpB genotype 159. In conclusion, targeted amplicon-based enrichment is the most accurate and reliable approach for epidemiological studies focused on AMR and mgpB typing, whereas DNA capture is valuable for generating comprehensive genomic data from selected M. genitalium-positive specimens.

papers.title: Functional analysis of NANOS protein variants identified in men with infertility employing zebrafish embryos
papers.translated_title: 应用斑马鱼胚胎对不育男性中鉴定出的NANOS蛋白变异体进行功能分析
papers.author: Madiwale, S.
papers.summary: Study questionAre vertebrate NANOS proteins associated with human fertility, and can a rapid in vivo assay in zebrafish be established to evaluate the biological activity of human NANOS variants? Summary answerCombining a rapid in vivo assay we developed for Nanos protein activity and patient-derived genetic data, we identified NANOS variants that could contribute to male infertility. What is known alreadyMale infertility affects approximately 17% of the population, but linking specific gene variants to this condition remains challenging. NANOS proteins are essential regulators of germ cell development in different model organisms; however, a rapid and robust in vivo assay for evaluating their activity in the context of human male infertility is currently lacking. Study design, size, durationExome/genome data from 3,338 men included in the Male Reproductive Genomics (MERGE) cohort were examined in this study. Of these, 2038 men showed severely impaired spermatogenesis but were otherwise healthy. Ninety-Six men with intact spermatogenesis were included in the study as controls. Additionally, the study included a targeted analysis of NANOS variants in 44 patients from the IMIGC cohort. Participants/materials, setting, methodsThe exome/genome data were screened for rare, stop-gain, frameshift, splice site, as well as missense variants in NANOS1, NANOS2, and NANOS3. Human amino acid substitutions were introduced at the corresponding positions in the zebrafish proteins. Ectopic co-expression of wild-type Dnd1 and Nanos3 in zebrafish embryos induces a germ cell-like fate in somatic cells, resulting in severe developmental defects and embryonic lethality. Based on this principle, we established a rapid in vivo assay in which wild-type Dnd1 was co-expressed with wild-type or variant Nanos2 and Nanos3 proteins in live zebrafish embryos, expecting early embryonic death if a variant protein is functional. This assay was used to evaluate the activity of NANOS2 and NANOS3 variants identified in men with infertility. Main results and the role of chanceIn human exome/genome sequencing data, we identified one heterozygous missense variant in NANOS2 and two heterozygous missense variants in NANOS3. The function of the variants was examined in the zebrafish using the in vivo assay we developed. Co-expression of wild-type Dnd1 with selected Nanos2 or Nanos3 variants identified in infertile men resulted in defects in induction of the germ cell-like phenotype, demonstrating the power of the biological readout for evaluating the potential effects of patient-derived variants on NANOS protein activity. Together, our analysis enabled the evaluation of single nucleotide variants, whose impact on protein function is difficult to predict, and allowed us to distinguish variants with little or no effect on protein function from those that strongly reduce activity and may potentially contribute to infertility. Limitations, reasons for cautionThe assay requires access to zebrafish embryos and basic imaging equipment. Although the functional conservation of NANOS proteins between zebrafish and humans is supported by previous studies, species-specific differences may influence protein activity. Therefore, the zebrafish assay should be considered one component of a broader framework for evaluating NANOS variants as contributing factor for infertility. Wider implications of the findingsUsing NANOS2 and NANOS3 as examples, we demonstrate that integrating clinical genetic data with functional cell and developmental biology can help establish links between candidate disease genes and human fertility. This strategy may apply to other germline-specific genes whose ectopic expression produces measurable developmental phenotypes in zebrafish embryos. papers.title: A cerebrospinal fluid metabolic signature of recovery in normal pressure hydrocephalus
papers.translated_title: 正常压力脑积水恢复的脑脊液代谢特征
papers.author: Duan, L.
papers.summary: Understanding the biological determinants of recovery of neurological function remains a major challenge. Normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) is characterized by urinary incontinence, gait impairment and cognitive decline. Notably, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) drainage can substantially improve symptoms, making NPH one of the few potentially reversible causes of dementia. However, postoperative benefit varies considerably between patients, and reliable preoperative predictors are lacking, leaving patients exposed to invasive intervention with uncertain likelihood of clinical benefit. We therefore asked whether preoperative CSF metabolic profiles capture biological states associated with neurological recovery. We studied a single-center cohort of 86 patients with NPH (mean age 74.7 years, range 59-90; 44 men, 42 women). We analyzed ventricular CSF from patients undergoing shunt surgery by semi-targeted (n = 42) and targeted (n = 55) mass spectrometry, with additional lumbar CSF (n = 29) and plasma (n = 33). Pathways identified in the discovery cohort were summarized as indices and tested in the targeted cohort on a locked dataset with a prespecified statistical analysis plan. A one-carbon/redox index, combining transsulfuration and choline metabolites, was associated with the number of symptom domains improved at 3 months (odds ratio 0.49 per SD, 95% CI 0.24-0.92; false discovery rate 0.051), most strongly for cognition, where lower index values accompanied improvement. Transcripts of the one-carbon pathway in CSF extracellular vesicles of the same patients shifted in the same direction (permutation p = 0.023; not significant after correction). Under nested cross-validation, a sparse metabolite model distinguished patients who improved cognitively, both in a leave-one-out implementation of our initial pipeline (AUC 0.79; permutation p = 0.028) and in the locked repeated 5-fold protocol (AUC 0.70; p = 0.046 after correction for model choice), and adding the prespecified indices to clinical covariates improved cognitive prediction; the prespecified full-metabolome model and models for gait and urinary outcomes did not exceed chance. These results point to one-carbon and choline metabolism as a candidate biological correlate of cognitive recovery after shunt surgery, to be tested in a prospective validation study.
papers.translated_summary: 理解神经功能恢复的生物学决定因素仍然是一项重大挑战。正常压力脑积水（NPH）以尿失禁、步态障碍和认知功能下降为特征。值得注意的是，脑脊液（CSF）引流可以显著改善症状，使NPH成为少数可能可逆的痴呆病因之一。然而，术后获益在患者之间差异相当大，且缺乏可靠的术前预测指标，使患者暴露于侵入性干预之下而临床获益的可能性不确定。因此，我们提出术前CSF代谢谱是否能捕捉与神经功能恢复相关的生物学状态。我们研究了一个单中心NPH患者队列，共86例（平均年龄74.7岁，范围59-90；男44例，女42例）。我们通过半靶向（n = 42）和靶向（n = 55）质谱分析接受分流手术患者的脑室CSF，并额外分析腰椎CSF（n = 29）和血浆（n = 33）。在发现队列中鉴定的通路被归纳为指数，并在锁定数据集上以预设的统计分析方案在靶向队列中进行检验。一个一碳/氧化还原指数，结合转硫途径和胆碱代谢物，与3个月时改善的症状域数量相关（每标准差比值比0.49，95% CI 0.24-0.92；错误发现率0.051），其中与认知的相关性最强，较低的指数值伴随改善。同一患者CSF细胞外囊泡中一碳通路的转录本向相同方向变化（置换检验p = 0.023；校正后不显著）。在嵌套交叉验证下，一个稀疏代谢物模型能够区分认知改善的患者，无论是在我们初始流程的留一法实现中（AUC 0.79；置换检验p = 0.028），还是在锁定的重复5折方案中（AUC 0.70；模型选择校正后p = 0.046），并且将预设指数加入临床协变量改善了认知预测；预设的全代谢组模型以及步态和泌尿结局的模型未超过随机水平。这些结果指向一碳和胆碱代谢作为分流手术后认知恢复的候选生物学相关因素，有待在前瞻性验证研究中检验。

papers.title: Adapting Clinical Event Annotation to Dutch Primary Care: An Event Annotation Framework for Post-Acute Infection Syndromes
papers.translated_title: 将临床事件标注适配于荷兰初级保健：针对急性感染后综合征的事件标注框架
papers.author: Mazzucato, S.
papers.summary: Clinical natural language processing (NLP) relies on language-specific corpora, which remain scarce for Dutch primary care. This limits the use of NLP to study post-acute infection syndromes (PAIS), such as post-COVID condition, as relevant symptoms and their temporal context are often documented in free-text general practitioner (GP) records rather than structured codes. The COVID-19 Annotated Clinical Text (CACT) framework was developed to identify COVID-19 diagnoses and related symptoms in English-language clinical notes, each represented as an event: a text span linked to its context, such as negation, timing and certainty. We translated and adapted CACT for Dutch primary care, extending its scope beyond COVID-19 to PAIS and other relevant infections and diagnoses, with annotation rules tailored to the four sections of Dutch GP notes (SOEP: Subjective, Objective, Evaluation, Plan). The revised framework distinguishes symptoms, acute infections, PAIS and other relevant diagnoses, and captures 11 types of supporting diagnostic evidence, including laboratory tests or physical examinations. It also differentiates uncertain diagnoses ('possibly post-COVID') from conditions mentioned but not asserted (e.g. a patient's fear of long COVID). In a pilot of 200 GP notes independently annotated by two annotators, overall span-level agreement over six core categories (symptoms, diagnoses, negation, evidence, timing and vital signs) was F1 = 0.51 (95% CI [0.47, 0.55]). Agreement increased to F1 = 0.78 [0.75, 0.80] when restricted to text spans marked by both annotators, suggesting that disagreement primarily concerned whether a mention was annotated at all, not which category it received. Future research should evaluate which parts of the revised framework generalise beyond Dutch primary care and PAIS.
papers.translated_summary: 临床自然语言处理（NLP）依赖于特定语言的语料库，而荷兰初级保健领域的此类语料库仍然稀缺。这限制了使用NLP研究急性感染后综合征（PAIS），如新冠感染后状况，因为相关症状及其时间背景通常记录在全科医生（GP）的自由文本记录中，而非结构化编码中。COVID-19标注临床文本（CACT）框架的开发旨在识别英文临床记录中的COVID-19诊断及相关症状，每个症状表示为一个事件：一个文本片段及其关联的上下文，如否定、时间和确定性。我们翻译并改编了CACT以适用于荷兰初级保健，将其范围从COVID-19扩展到PAIS及其他相关感染和诊断，并针对荷兰全科医生记录的四部分（SOEP：主观、客观、评估、计划）定制了标注规则。修订后的框架区分症状、急性感染、PAIS及其他相关诊断，并捕获11类支持性诊断证据，包括实验室检查或体格检查。它还将不确定的诊断（“可能新冠后”）与提及但未断言的状况（例如患者对长新冠的恐惧）区分开来。在由两名标注者独立标注200份全科医生记录的试点中，六个核心类别（症状、诊断、否定、证据、时间和生命体征）的总体片段级一致性为F1 = 0.51（95% CI [0.47, 0.55]）。当仅限于两名标注者均标记的文本片段时，一致性提高至F1 = 0.78 [0.75, 0.80]，表明分歧主要在于某提及是否被标注，而非其被归入哪个类别。未来研究应评估修订框架的哪些部分可推广至荷兰初级保健和PAIS之外的领域。

papers.title: Neural networks for dengue forecasting: a systematic review
papers.translated_title: 用于登革热预测的神经网络：一项系统综述
papers.author: Piva, L. L. d. S.
papers.summary: Background: Early dengue forecasts are an important tool for disease mitigation, and neural networks (NNs) are powerful predictive models that have contributed to many areas of public health. We reviewed NN applications in the dengue forecasting literature to inform model design for future studies. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, we systematically searched Web of Science/Knowledge, Scopus, PubMed, and Science Direct up to September 2025 for studies using NNs to forecast dengue in human populations, retrieving 628 records. After removing duplicates, four inclusion and two exclusion criteria were applied: articles had to be in English, implement NN or deep learning techniques, predict dengue fever incidence or risk, and clearly state data sources, processing steps, network parameters, and architectures. Results: Sixty two papers were included and summarized by relative performance of neural networks and comparator models, architectures and hyper-parameters, choices of input features, geographic spread, and model transparency. Most studies (35 out of 62) implemented shallow feed-forward neural networks, using historical dengue incidence and climate variables as the most common input features, with 43 appearances. Target variables were dengue cases, severity and hotspots, and risk of outbreak, with model selection and evaluation approach being non uniform. Most studies (25) used granular observations at the city level or its subdivisions, while also commonly employing data from weekly measurements (35 out of 62). Performance of neural networks relative to comparators, such as tree-based supervised models, varied across study contexts. We found that 63% of studies included such models in their baseline; of these, approximately half found neural networks to outperform the baseline, although most do not include statistical comparisons. Conclusions: The studies suggest that neural networks, although useful in specific scenarios, are not consistently found to be superior to simpler predictive models, especially tree-based machine learning methods.
